preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 2013, inclusive.
The length of the string S in each test case is between 1 and 2013, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each character in S is either a capital letter from 'A' to 'Z' or the question mark '?'
preconditions.description: The characters in the string S are limited to capital letters and question marks.

postconditions.expression: Output the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained from S by replacing all question marks with capital letters and maximizing the number of substrings equal to 'CHEF'
postconditions.description: The output string must contain the maximum possible number of 'CHEF' substrings and be lexicographically smallest.
